summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the redesigned Evaluación 'Aspectos' view (EvaluationSection.js) inside Control Médico. Verified table-by-default toggle, category tables with icon/color/count, connected real data, inline edit + autosave (Guardando…/Guardado), out-of-range red styling, mini % bar, add row, delete row with confirm, toggle to Formulario (regression cards) and back, and regression on Fortalezas / Áreas de mejora / manual Save / evolution chart. All acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: DialogContent missing DialogTitle — accessibility warning in console (not blocking UX). Wrap title with VisuallyHidden.
React hydration error: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by nested elements/instrumentation inside <option>. Should render plain text inside <option> only.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap Radix DialogContent title with a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to remove a11y warnings.
(Optional) Ensure <option> children in the athlete select render only text (no <span>) to fix React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationSection.js AspectTable + autosave path is clean and well-tested. displayMode defaults to 'table' as required (line 278). scheduleAutoSave debounces 1.2s (line 384-387). aspectPct/aspectOutOfRange helpers correctly clamp 0-100 and detect >max/<min. All required data-testids exist (eval-{type}-toolbar, view-table, view-form, table-{cat}, trow-{id}, tvalue-{id}, tremove-{id}, tadd, autosave).
Console warnings about accessibility DialogTitle and <span> inside <option> should be addressed for hygiene.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing plan 'Plan Test API' owned by test coach; Control Médico had category 'Gen' with 2 aspects (Métrica A: min 0/max 100/target 60/value 80). Autosaved values persisted from previous tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the evaluation table: login (test@train.com/test123456) → Datos tab → 'Ver mis planes' → select 'Plan Test API' → click top-nav Evaluación icon → subnav 'Control Médico'. Toolbar is [data-testid=eval-medical-toolbar]; toggle buttons eval-medical-view-table (default selected with bg-white shadow) / eval-medical-view-form; tables eval-medical-table-{category}; rows eval-medical-trow-{aspectId}; value input eval-medical-tvalue-{aspectId}; delete eval-medical-tremove-{aspectId}; add eval-medical-tadd; autosave indicator eval-medical-autosave shows 'Guardando…' then 'Guardado'. Persistence uses POST /api/plan-data/evaluations-export (MongoDB).

verified_flows.toolbar_and_default_table_view: PASS — toolbar visible; view-table selected by default (bg-white shadow class present).
verified_flows.table_renders_with_real_data: PASS — eval-medical-table-Gen renders 2 aspects; first row {label:'Métrica A', unit:'', min:'0', max:'100', target:'60', value:'80'}; header columns Aspecto/Unidad/Mín/Máx/Objetivo/Valor Medido/% Cumplimiento/Nota confirmed.
verified_flows.inline_edit_autosave: PASS — typing '42' into tvalue triggers autosave indicator that reaches 'Guardado' state within ~1.5s. Existing value 80 already persisted from previous runs confirms MongoDB persistence.
verified_flows.out_of_range_red: PASS — value 999999 (>max 100) applies bg-red-50, border-red-300, text-red-600 on the cell.
verified_flows.add_row_per_category: PASS — clicking eval-medical-tadd appended a new row (2→3).
verified_flows.delete_row_confirm: PASS — clicking eval-medical-tremove-{id} triggered a browser confirm; on accept the row was removed (3→2) and autosaved.
verified_flows.toggle_form_view_regression: PASS — eval-medical-view-form renders 12 legacy aspect cards; toggle back to eval-medical-view-table restores the table.
verified_flows.regression_manual_save_and_textareas_and: PASS — eval-medical-fortalezas, eval-medical-areas-mejora, eval-medical-save-btn, and 'Evolución de este control' chart all present and interactive.

rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only two non-blocking console warnings: (1) Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle (a11y); (2) React hydration error: <span> nested inside <option> in the athlete select dropdown. Both are hygiene items unrelated to the current Aspectos redesign.
